card.name: Words introducing metals or additives
card.fires_on: The word 'containing' (also 'without', 'a', or an opening bracket) right before a list of metals or additives such as aluminum, magnesium, iron, zinc, or a bacteriostatic agent.

modes.label: Containing before metals
modes.description: 'Containing' links an antacid or solution to the metal ions it holds.
modes.example: Absorption of tetracyclines is impaired by antacids<< containing>> aluminum, calcium, or magnesium, b

modes.label: Without before an additive
modes.description: 'Without' in brackets after a diluent name, ahead of a preservative.
modes.example: 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP (<<without>> a bacteriostatic agent)

modes.label: Chelator description
modes.description: A linking word just before a chelating agent or metal ion is described.
modes.example: contains edetate disodium (the salt form of EDTA),<< a>> chelator of metal ions including zinc
